# EyeDetect Lviv — lie detector (polygraph) testing in Ukraine

> Certified Converus partner in Ukraine. EyeDetect eye-tracking lie detector in Lviv and on-site across Ukraine and Europe, VerifEye online test from a smartphone. Examiner: Nataliia Marynyak, psychologist, certified EyeDetect Test Proctor.

Site: https://www.eye-polygraph.com/ (Ukrainian), https://www.eye-polygraph.com/en/ (English), https://www.eye-polygraph.com/ru/ (Russian)
Office: 45 Horodotska St., Lviv, Ukraine. Phone: +380 68 68 333 68. Email: info@eye-polygraph.com

## Key facts
- EyeDetect (Converus, USA): 30–45 minute test, no sensors on the body, the algorithm scores the test (Credibility Score 1–99), accuracy 86–90% per Converus validation studies.
- VerifEye (Converus): online test from a smartphone, about 10 minutes, accuracy 84–89%, PDF report after the test.
- Prices (Lviv, 2026): EyeDetect single issue UAH 5,500; up to three issues UAH 8,500; VerifEye online UAH 2,500 / 4,000; business screening on request; on-site travel within Lviv region included.
- Results are not court evidence in Ukraine; used for internal investigations, HR screening, fidelity checks and settlements.
